title: chore(ui)!: stop publishing @object-ui/app-shell; delete the two host-console examples and the extraction guide (#25922)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97Wh4Pf8UgMzHvahNM6Rh28)_

Part of #25922 (the unpublish-and-delete item of ruling 6431234244 only; the designer strings (M) item and the 76 Console-only names stay on the card).
Clause-②: `yes (narrowing)`: a published package leaves the registry; ADR-0087 marker per the lane's rules
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@object-ui/app-shell` 标为 `private: true`，移出 changesets 的 fixed 组；删除 `ui/examples/byo-backend-console`、`ui/examples/console-starter` 和 `ui/docs/app-shell-extraction-guide.md`，并清掉指向它们的链接与索引。Console 和 23 个工作区引用方不动。
- 为什么改：执行 #25922 的重裁 Q1 = B（6431234244）：「本项目的组件就是为 objectos console服务的，可定制console暂时没有业务需求，可以废弃」「相关例子也可以删除」。
- 风险与回滚：18.2.0 是 npm 上最后一个发布的 `@object-ui/app-shell`（18.2 版本 PR 已把它记到 18.2.0，18.2 发布从版本提交 27f38ada 发出）；之后由你执行 `npm deprecate`。私有包仍按 `privatePackages.version: true` 单独记版本，点名它的待发 changeset 不用改。回滚 = revert 本 PR。改动 2979 行（上限 3000），其中 2824 行是删除。
- 先看：`.changeset/25922-unpublish-app-shell.md`（BREAKING 说明与 ADR-0087 `unpublished` 标记）、`ui/scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`（私有包不在 fixed、不在 ignore 时的分类规则）、`ui/packages/app-shell/package.json`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs && node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`，预期两行 ✓，后者点名 `not-required (unpublished)`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。（另有一行受管文件 `ui/.claude/**` 的修改不在本 PR，见 Acceptance notes。）

## Why

Ruling 6431234244 on #25922 re-rules Q1 to B: `@object-ui/app-shell` stops being published, and the two examples that consume it as a third-party host would, plus the extraction guide that describes that posture, are deleted. The split in 6431032267 is withdrawn.

## What changes

**The package leaves npm.**
- `ui/packages/app-shell/package.json`: `private: true`, beside the `18.2.0` version the 18.2 Version PR set. Nothing else in the manifest moves; every workspace importer keeps `workspace:*`.
- `.changeset/config.json`: `@object-ui/app-shell` leaves the `fixed` group. The root `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` refuses an undeclared private member there, so it cannot stay. No hand-typed package count moves with it: #26511 took those counts out of the docs and retired `check-lockstep-package-count`.
- `ui/scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` (the ui roster gate, read by its test in Test UI): rule 1 required every package to be in `fixed` or matched by `ignore`. A private package outside both is now classified too, but only while `privatePackages.version` is true. In that case Changesets versions it on its own and publishes it nowhere. Under `version: false` it would be treated as ignored, and the mixed-changeset failure rule 3 describes would follow, so it stays unclassified there. `ignore` was not an option: before the 18.2 Version PR, 48 pending changesets named `@object-ui/app-shell` beside published packages, and `ignore` makes any such changeset a mixed one. New unit case in `check-changeset-fixed.test.ts`, covering both directions.

**The host-console posture leaves the tree.**
- Deleted: `ui/examples/byo-backend-console` (11 files), `ui/examples/console-starter` (16 files, its two tests included), `ui/docs/app-shell-extraction-guide.md`. `pnpm-lock.yaml` loses their two importers (deletions only).
- Links and indexes: `ui/README.md` (the Quick Start rows, the "Bring your own backend" section that taught `npm install @object-ui/app-shell`, the run-the-examples block, the package-table row), `ui/examples/README.md`, `ui/examples/hello-world/README.md`, `ui/examples/schema-catalog/README.md`, `ui/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` (Examples section, published count 36 → 35 with `app-shell` named among the private packages), `ui/content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx` (the dead objectui-repo link), `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` (a not-published notice, the install section, two example pointers), and three app-shell source comments that sent the reader to `examples/console-starter/src/App.tsx`.
- `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`: the retired guide leaves four `reads` entries (`--audit`: 73 declared entries, all present).
- `tsconfig.tier-base.json`: no package's build or type-check program reaches it any more (the deleted `byo-backend-console` was the one real compile that did). `turbo-build-inputs` / `turbo-type-check-inputs` prescribe deleting the dead input, so `$TURBO_ROOT$/tsconfig.tier-base.json` leaves both tasks in `ui/turbo.objectui.json` and `$TURBO_ROOT$/ui/tsconfig.tier-base.json` leaves the live root `turbo.json`. The two header comments that counted its extenders say 2.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/25922-unpublish-app-shell.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` (Metadata-protocol `none`), BREAKING banner, the FROM npm → TO none migration line, and the marker `adr-0087: not-required (unpublished)`. The gate verifies that category mechanically: every package the changeset bumps is `private: true` at HEAD. It states that `18.2.0` is the last published `@object-ui/app-shell` (the 18.2 Version PR versioned it before this change and the 18.2 publish ships it) and that the maintainer runs `npm deprecate` after that publish. The migration line names `@object-ui/app-shell@18.2.0`.

**Untouched, as ruled:** `ui/apps/console` and the 23 `ui/packages/*` importers; the other `@object-ui/*` packages' publishing; the 76 Console-only names.

### Forced test edits (each follows the deletion or the private flag; none relaxes a check)

- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts`: the root `docs/*.md` leg's only real page was the retired guide. "listDocuments reaches them" and "the widening judges something" now prove the leg on a fixture `docs/PAGE.md`: it is listed, covered and contributes a compiled block. Every real page the leg reaches must still be covered.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-fence-languages.test.ts`: same leg, same cause; the per-leg non-empty check reads the root leg on a fixture page.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts`: `examples` scan floor 4 → 3 (the index, hello-world, schema-catalog READMEs).
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts`: the `examples/byo-backend-console` row leaves the recorded exclusion, as its own failure text prescribes for a member that left.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/side-effects-declaration-consistency.test.ts`: the `@object-ui/layout` alias tables are `apps/console/vite.config.ts` alone.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-type-check-coverage.test.ts`: packages with tests outside `src/` are `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` alone.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/package-files-exist.test.ts`: the license-text anti-vacuity floor 37 → 36 (36 measured, `app-shell` no longer publishes).
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts`: no `examples/*` package declares `dev` any more. The test asked for the section to be rewritten, not re-pinned. With no runnable example, it now pins the section's "No directory under `examples/` is a dev server" sentence and refuses any example dev command. When an example grows a `dev` script, the sentence reds and the original per-example check takes over.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-fixed.test.ts`: the new rule's unit case (above).

## Tests

After merging main past the 18.2 Version PR (#25640) and #26511, head `443aad7b`: `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `node ui/scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `pnpm run check:publish-smoke-pin`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:overlay-whitelist-table`, `check:route-ledger-census`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` (`not-required (unpublished)`), `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-no-major` (`--base origin/main`), `node ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs` and `pnpm exec changeset status --since=origin/main` all exit 0. The full release plan assembled with `@changesets/cli` 3.0.3's own read/config/assemble packages reads all 13 pending changesets with exit 0: `@object-ui/app-shell` 18.2.0 → 18.2.1 on its own (private, publishes nothing), the fixed group 18.2.0 → 18.3.0. `vitest run` on `quick-reference-commands-4149`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-doc-links`, `package-files-exist`, `check-skills-paths`: 5 files, 198 tests passed.

The readings below were measured at head `160fe489` in the card thread's container.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/ --maxWorkers=2` under the verify lock, after the Console build: Test Files 1 failed | 177 passed | 2 skipped (180), Tests 4 failed | 5053 passed. The 4 are all `check-skills-paths.test.ts`, one cause: the governed guide line in Acceptance notes. With that line's patch applied locally, `check-skills-paths.test.ts` is 35/35 and `node ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs` exits 0. The patch was then restored; it is not in this diff.
- Console build: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console --concurrency=2` under the lock: `Tasks: 70 successful, 70 total`, VERDICT command-exit 0, and the tree was clean afterwards (`sdui.manifest.json` unchanged).
- `node ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit`: 109 candidate test files, all adjudicated; 73 declared entries, all present.

Dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm owes it), final head `160fe489`: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 1, Test Files 2 failed | 298 passed | 3 skipped (303), Tests 10 failed | 2522 passed | 18 skipped (2550). All 10 are outside this diff, which touches no file under `packages/rest`, `packages/qa` or `packages/spec`: `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` (4: `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts` controls 81 vs pinned 80, `rest-server.ts` 63/70 vs 62/69) and `authz-conformance.test.ts` (6: the #17111 docblock-figure pins). Both census files last moved in 6a2866af on main, which added a route; the dogfood battery runs only on main's full schedule, so this reads as a main-side red, reported to the seat.

## Verification

Local subset, derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `160fe489` (107 families) and run after the last commit; every exit code captured before any pipe.

<details><summary>dispatch-gates --ran: exit 0, 107 accounted, 106 run, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- 105 commands exit 0, including `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (`not-required (unpublished)` judged), `check-changeset-fixed` (109 public packages, 1 declared private member), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:lockstep-package-count`, `check:publish-smoke-pin`, `check:published-files`, `check:turbo-task-graph`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 380 s).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`: first exit 3 (prerequisite: `@objectstack/client-react` unbuilt), then exit 0 after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client-react build` (264 prose examples type-check).
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (reads every package `dist/`, which needs a whole-repo build). The diff touches no package build; CI `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran RECORD`: `107 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 106 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.

</details>

Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check runs; none was re-run locally to stand in for them.

## Acceptance notes

- **Governed follow-up, landed separately (Tier H).** The `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` bullet that told contributors to fork `examples/console-starter` was rewritten in #26484 (merged), so `check-skills-paths` is green here without this PR touching `ui/.claude/**`.
- **Pending changesets naming `@object-ui/app-shell`:** 48 at first; the 18.2 Version PR consumed them, and 2 others are pending now. None edited. A private package versions under `privatePackages.version: true`, and `changeset status --since=origin/main` computes a plan with `@object-ui/app-shell` versioned on its own (no refusal). `check-empty-changeset`: no changeset from the merge base modified or deleted.
- **Found on main earlier, since fixed there:** `.changeset/26095-publishing-metadata.md` had its closing frontmatter delimiter glued to its last line, so `changeset status` exited 1 on main. #26458 fixed it; the readings at `443aad7b` above ran on the unmodified tree.
- After this PR, `DefaultLoginPage` / `DefaultRegisterPage` have no in-repo mount (only `console-starter` mounted them; the Console has its own pages). That falls under the card's internal tech-debt line, not this PR.
- Comments and test docblocks in other packages that mention the deleted examples historically (`plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx`, `plugin-list/ListView.tsx`, `plugin-detail/headerColor.ts`, `cli/doctor.ts`, several `ui/scripts` docblocks) and the CHANGELOGs are left as written. Editing them is outside the claimed file surface, and `ObjectView.tsx` is held by another card.
- Diff size: 155 additions + 2824 deletions = 2979 changed lines, under the 3,000-line Tier H threshold.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (lint is CI's run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
